description: The merchant approved cancelling one order and a reply that also answered a question about a second order. Shopify refused the cancellation because the order had shipped, so the approved reply was withheld. The follow-up attempt must tell the customer what actually happened and still answer the independent question.
whyModelNeeded: The model must recover from a definite provider failure with an honest, useful message, without claiming the failed action and without dropping the part of the request that did not depend on it.

messages.contentText: Hi, please cancel order #1410, I ordered the wrong size. Also, has #1402 shipped yet?

simulateToolResults.result: Reply sent to customer via email.

instruction:
Customer wants order #1410 cancelled because they ordered the wrong size, and asks whether order #1402 has shipped.

The merchant approved steps and a message to the customer. The message was not sent: an approved step did not succeed, so the message would not have been true.

What the approved steps did:
- cancel_order (error): Error: Shopify could not cancel order #1410: the order has already been fulfilled.

Draft one message to the customer that tells them what actually happened and what happens next. Claim nothing the steps above do not show succeeded. Do not change the store; the merchant decides whether to try again.

checks.description: The reply says order #1410 could not be cancelled because it had already shipped, and does not claim it was cancelled or refunded. It offers a useful next step (for example returning it once it arrives, or that the team will follow up), and it still answers that #1402 has shipped.
